LanguageData.ChemfuelPuddle.label: chemfuel puddle
LanguageData.ChemfuelPuddle.description: A puddle of sticky, flammable chemfuel.
LanguageData.ChemfuelTripwire.label: chemfuel trap
LanguageData.ChemfuelTripwire.description: A tripwire hooked up to an igniting device and installed over a puddle of flammable chemfuel. When triggered, it ignites a roaring fire in a concentrated area. Can be built next to each other.
LanguageData.Electric_Arc.label: electric arc
LanguageData.GlueTrap.label: glue trap
LanguageData.GlueTrap.description: A puddle of smeared insect jelly. The substance is extremely sticky, making passage difficult. While it is waterproof and will remain sticky for a long time, the substance is also flammable.
LanguageData.GrenadeBouquet.label: grenade bouquet
LanguageData.GrenadeBouquet.description: A tripwire hooked up to a bundle of frag grenades and a flashbang. When triggered, the grenades will depin and scatter on the ground as the flashbang detonates and stuns those nearby. Highly effective and equally destructive.
LanguageData.Live_Grenade.label: live grenade
LanguageData.Tesla_Coil.label: tesla coil
LanguageData.Tesla_Coil.description: A tesla coil made to be mounted on a turret.
LanguageData.Tesla_Coil.verbs.Verb_Shoot.label: tesla coil
LanguageData.Turret_TeslaStunner.label: tesla stunner
LanguageData.Turret_TeslaStunner.description: A portable tesla coil based stunning device. Requires maintenance after prolonged use and may cause an electrical explosion when damaged. When a target enters its range, it will direct an arc of electricity to continuously stun them until disabled.
